title: Connect your system
description: Describe your own system (accounting, e-commerce, SaaS) on one screen: concepts, where the data comes from, what can be done and how the AI should work.
connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Your system's address and authentication. Every endpoint is written relative to it.
connection.name: Name
connection.secret_kept: The saved value is kept; type a new one to change it
connection.secret_help: Stored encrypted, never shown again and masked in logs.
connection.security: Only public https addresses are called; private, local and cloud metadata addresses are refused. Redirects are not followed and each organization may make 60 calls a minute.
concepts.title: 1. Concepts
concepts.description: The objects of your system: Company, Package, License, Invoice; in e-commerce Order, Shipment, Return. Concepts are custom object types.
concepts.empty: No concepts yet. Add one below.
source.title: 2. Where the data comes from: {{concept}}
source.description: This concept is read from your system by the customer's external id. Write the endpoint, try it with a real id and pick the fields by clicking the answer.
source.path_help: {external_id} is the customer's id and {company_external_id} the company's id in your system. The endpoint must hold one of them.
source.items_path: Where are the records in the answer?
source.fields: Picked fields and the names the AI sees
actions.title: 3. What can be done
actions.description: Actions such as "Resend the invoice" or "Start a refund": which endpoint they call, whether they need approval and who may use them.
actions.dialog_help: The endpoint is relative to your system's base URL. Params can be used in it as {key}; the rest are sent as the JSON body.
actions.description_label: Description (shown to the AI and members)
actions.params_help: The customer's external id is added automatically; do not define it as a param.
actions.requires_approval: A member must approve before it runs
actions.approval_note: The AI and workflows cannot run actions that need approval; only a member can approve and run them.
actions.surfaces: Actions open to members appear as a confirmation card in the assistant and as the integrations_actions_run tool in MCP clients; actions open to workflows are used with the "Run a connected system action" step.
playbooks.title: 4. Tell the AI how to work
playbooks.description: Write in plain sentences, as you would to a new colleague. The customer's free sentence is classified by the AI and the matching playbook applies; no keyword matching is used.
playbooks.dialog_help: The playbook fetches the chosen concepts by the customer's external id and adds them to the AI's reply input.
playbooks.instructions_placeholder: If they say their invoice was not sent, look at Invoice; if the status is Error, read the error text and hand it to the technical team.
playbooks.matching_help: The title and playbook are given to the AI classification as an intent candidate, so it matches even when the customer uses other words.
playbooks.actions_help: Only actions open to the AI that need no approval are run by the AI.
preview.title: 5. Try as this customer
preview.description: Enter what the widget would send for one customer: ClickFix shows what it accepts or rejects, why, and the context the AI sees for this customer. Nothing is saved.
preview.events: Events (one name or JSON per line)
preview.attributes_invalid: Attributes must be a JSON object.
preview.ai_context_empty: No context would be added for the AI.
rejection.WIDGET_IDENTITY_DISABLED: Identity verification is off on the widget; set an identity secret.
rejection.WIDGET_IDENTITY_INVALID: user_hash did not match the signature computed from user_id and the widget identity secret.
calls.title: Recent calls
calls.description: The latest 20 calls to your system. Secrets are masked and bodies are not stored.
